lines.text: After twenty years of building, Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre.
Hiram inspected the towns, was not pleased, and called them the Land of Cabul.
Pharaoh king of Egypt captured and burned Gezer, then gave it as a dowry to his daughter.
Solomon conscripted the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites still in the land as forced laborers.
Seven times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he built for the LORD.
